'''Farede''' was an early [[Panarch]] of [[Tarabon]], who reigned around the year {{ne|1}}. 
==History==
Farede was the sponsor of a new calendar introduced by [[Uren din Jubai Soaring Gull]] in light of the chaos of the [[War of the Hundred Years]]. He is especially known for wanting to make [[Tanchico]] the intellectual capital of the world.

The new calendar was adopted by academics across the [[Westlands]], and became known as the Farede Calendar in honor of the Panarch.{{ref/book|bwb}}
